scope: Production-model WebGL2 compatibility fixture after GP R3.1/R4, glow and shared paint integration. Vite bundles current production imports into a test-owned page; this is not the full game journey or a hardware performance benchmark.

actualExecution.scope: The GP case ran second in one sequential, single-worker three-test Playwright process together with filtered crowd11 and MX42.
actualExecution.combinedCommand: npx playwright test -c playwright.motocross.config.ts e2e/11-phase27c.spec.ts e2e/41-motogp-reference.spec.ts e2e/42-motocross-bike.spec.ts --grep 'actual crowd colour/depth shaders freeze and rewind exactly|GP reference R1.1:|Motocross reference R2:'
actualExecution.combinedCommandProvenance: Exact root-provided command for completed session72694; matches the three filtered tests in the retained combined reporter.

test.title: GP reference R1.1: authored LODs, production onboard and same-instance wet rewind on WebGL2

source.sourceHashEncoding: SHA-256 of UTF-8 compact JSON (separators comma/colon), with lexicographically sorted path keys; values are file SHA-256 digests.

sourceIntegrity.method: Complete dictionary equality of all670 source hashes,12 context hashes, build identity and both main-bundle hashes against the post-run capture.

errorCheck: The completed spec explicitly asserted its accumulated pageerror and console.error list equals []; renderer GL errors were zero in every capture.

triangleMetricDefinitions.triangles: All geometry in the constructed bike/rider model, multiplying every InstancedMesh by count. The110000 ceiling applies here.
triangleMetricDefinitions.submittedTriangles: WebGLRenderer.info.render.triangles after the draw, including repeated color/transmission submissions after the shadow-pass counter reset; view-dependent and distinct from complete-model cost.

visualReview.scope: Individual visual observations are owned and maintained separately from this automated-test and capture-provenance record.

limitations: This controlled fixture does not re-run the earlier full-game main45 journey.
SwiftShader execution time is not a physical-GPU frame-rate measurement.
The individual image observations are maintained in the separately owned visual-review.json.
CPU integration batches and historical667-source evidence retain their actual scopes; they are not relabelled as this renderer run.
